google/gemini-2.5-flash.mistake: The FOL statement `∀x (p_5(x) ⊕ p_15(x))` uses the XOR operator (`⊕`), which means 'exclusive or' (one or the other, but not both). The natural language statement 'For all x, x remains dormant if and only if x evolves over time' uses 'if and only if', which corresponds to the biconditional operator (`↔`). These two logical connectives have different truth conditions. `A ↔ B` is true when A and B are both true, or A and B are both false. `A ⊕ B` is true when A is true and B is false, or A is false and B is true.
